summary: First-run E2E testing of Sapa Food FARM stack. All 30 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend public pages (CZ+EN), redirects, language switcher, hero video attrs, menu (10 cats/53 items with specific-item spot-checks), daily menu empty state, EN CZ fallback, JSON-LD Restaurant, sitemap/robots/openapi, admin login/logout, admin daily editor UI and admin regular menu editor all verified. Note: an initial front-end cache issue served the Emergent scaffold index.html (missing JSON-LD, wrong title); a supervisor restart resolved it — main agent should be aware if the same happens after future public/index.html edits.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to an unknown admin sub-route (e.g. /admin/jidelni-listek instead of /admin/menu) triggers 'Maximum update depth exceeded' React error and hundreds of aborted requests instead of a single clean redirect to /admin/denni-menu. The relative <Navigate to="denni-menu" replace /> inside the nested Routes appears to loop with the outer /admin/* route. Not user-reachable via UI (all nav links use correct paths) but is a genuine SPA bug.

After changes to public/index.html, CRA dev server can serve a stale/emergent scaffold index.html (title 'Emergent | Fullstack App' with no JSON-LD, no hreflang) until frontend is restarted. Consider baking these SEO tags via a runtime component (react-helmet/react 19 <title>) to avoid dependence on dev-server template refresh.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate the /admin/wildcard→denni-menu render loop; consider absolute path '/admin/denni-menu' in the fallback Navigate.
OPTIONAL: Ensure SEO tags in public/index.html survive dev-server template caching (already served correctly after restart).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: login rate limit is per (ip+email) — good; but note x-forwarded-for is trusted without allowlist. Fine behind Kubernetes ingress but callout for future prod hardening.
routes_admin.py oid() returns 404 on invalid ObjectId — good UX.
AuthContext.jsx: user state uses null/false/object triple-state — clean.
AdminApp.jsx renders raw <title> and <meta> tags directly in JSX. In React 18/CRA this puts them in <body>, not <head>. Works but semantically wrong for SEO/robots.
api.js imgUrl returns '' on empty input — good (prevents empty loop).
server.py: FIELD_LABELS is fine, but validation_handler could join messages with newlines/HTML instead of single string for better UI display.

rca of the issue: 1) /admin/jidelni-listek loop: nested <Routes> in AdminApp has a wildcard <Navigate to="denni-menu" replace /> that appears to interact poorly with the outer /admin/* Route in App.js when the URL segment isn't one of the defined children, causing repeated remounts. Fix: use absolute path (to="/admin/denni-menu"), or make the fallback a static component instead of Navigate. 2) Stale index.html: CRA dev server (webpack) had cached the emergent scaffold template before /app/frontend/public/index.html was modified. Fix: supervisorctl restart frontend or move SEO content into an in-tree component so it re-renders on hot reload.
